comments.value: Same here. Sitting in any seat be it either on an avatar or a world seat locks up the vrc scaler.

In Desktop the seat scales the avatar to a crazy size and the avatar goes upside down & when walking out the avatar crouches or is very far away from the camera and requires the avatar to be reset after respawning. Also, the dynamics aren't working in motion capture animations anymore. Some dynamics are still & some have a gravity set to 1 only during the animation.

create a layer at bottom in gesture controller - add a state with wd off - stations now dont make you larger every time you sit on it - does not matter if any other layer uses wd on,  long as last is wd off

details:
1. Use a station in a VRChat world.

2. Change avatar height either while still in station or after exiting
